berry.Cheri.0: This bright red Berry is very spicy and has a provocative flavor. It blooms with delicate, pretty flowers.
berry.Chesto.0: This Berry's thick skin and fruit are very tough and dry-tasting. However, every bit of it can be eaten.
berry.Pecha.0: Because of its hollow inside pocket, there isn't a lot to eat. What can be eaten is very sweet and delicious.
berry.Rawst.0: If the leaves grow longer and curlier than average, this Berry will have a somewhat-bitter taste.
berry.Aspear.0: This Berry's peel is hard, but the flesh inside is very juicy. It is distinguished by its bracing sourness.
berry.Leppa.0: It takes longer to grow than Berries such as Cheri. The smaller Berries taste better.
berry.Oran.0: Nature's gifts came together as one in this Berry. It has a wondrous mix of flavors that spread in the mouth.
berry.Sitrus.0: Sitrus came from the same family as Oran. It is larger and smoother-tasting than Oran.
berry.Persim.0: The more this Berry absorbs energy from sunlight, the more vividly colorful it grows.
berry.Razz.0: A small hint of spiciness lingers in the red granules surrounding this Berry. Their centers have a dry taste.
berry.Bluk.0: Though this small, delicately-skinned Berry is blue in color, it dyes the mouth black when eaten.
berry.Nanab.0: Bitter, but with a trace of sweetness, the Nanab Berry was the seventh to be discovered in the world.
berry.Wepear.0: The potent mix of bitter and sour in this Berry seems to promote digestion. The flower is white and beautiful.
berry.Pinap.0: It is said that when the sour skin is peeled, this spicy Berry can be crushed to make medicine.
berry.Figy.0: This Berry is oddly shaped, appearing as if someone took a bite out of it. It is packed full of spicy substances.
berry.Wiki.0: It is said that this Berry grew lumps to help Pokémon grip it, allowing propagation farther afield.
berry.Mago.0: This Berry progressively curves as it grows. The curvier the Berry, the sweeter and tastier.
berry.Aguav.0: This Berry turns bitter toward the stem. The dainty flower it grows from doesn't absorb much sunlight.
berry.Iapapa.0: This Berry is very big and sour. The juiciness of the pulp accentuates the sourness.
berry.Lum.0: This Berry's gradual process of storing nutrients beneficial to Pokémon health causes it to mature slowly.
berry.Lum.1: This Berry multiplies the effect of Berry plants around it.
berry.Pomeg.0: When this sweetly spicy Berry's thick skin is peeled, many pieces of the fruit spill out.
berry.Kelpsy.0: This Berry can be eaten as is or boiled to obtain an extract that adds a dash of flavor to food.
berry.Qualot.0: Even in places of constant rain and high humidity, this Berry's plant grows healthy and strong.
berry.Hondew.0: This somewhat-rare Berry projects an image of luxury, so it is favored as a gift item.
berry.Grepa.0: One bite of this very tender Berry fills the mouth with its sweet and tangy flavor.
berry.Tamato.0: This Berry is large and spicy. When eaten during the cold season, it warms the body from inside.
berry.Cornn.0: Its dryness is quite strong. As a result, its true deliciousness can't be appreciated by just eating one or two.
berry.Magost.0: The grown-up flavor and dreamy sweetness of this Berry make it a favorite of Pokémon everywhere.
berry.Rabuta.0: Even though it is bitter, it should be eaten peel and all. The hair on the peel cleans the stomach from the inside.
berry.Nomel.0: This Berry is quite sour overall, with the sourness especially concentrated at the pointed end.
berry.Spelon.0: So spicy is the Spelon Berry that, Fire type or not, Pokémon will try to breathe fire after eating a single one.
berry.Pamtre.0: This Berry drifted from a faraway sea. It is now cultivated in the Sinnoh region.
berry.Pamtre.1: It has a tendency to expand into nearby plots.
berry.Watmel.0: A bounty of nature that is exceedingly sweet. The Berry is huge, with some discovered that exceed 20″, or 50 cm.
berry.Durin.0: This Berry is tremendously bitter. Just one bite is enough to instantly stop hiccups.
berry.Belue.0: This glossy and colorful Berry has a mouthwateringly delicious appearance. However, it is awfully sour.
berry.Pinkan.0: This Berry endemic to Pinkan Island has an incredibly sweet taste.
berry.Pinkan.1: It has a vibrant pink pigment, and it is found in such abundance on Pinkan Island that all Pokémon found there are colored Pink!
berry.Occa.0: This Berry is said to have grown plentiful in the tropics of the past. It boasts an intensely hot spiciness.
berry.Occa.1: It has a tendency to overtake nearby plants.
berry.Passho.0: This Berry's flesh is dotted with countless tiny bubbles of air that keep it afloat in water.
berry.Passho.1: This Berry promotes the fruiting of nearby Berry plants.
berry.Wacan.0: Energy from lightning strikes is drawn into the plant, making the Berries grow big and rich.
berry.Wacan.1: The same energy promotes the growth of nearby Berries.
berry.Rindo.0: This Berry has a disagreeable "green" flavor and scent typical of vegetables. It is rich in health-promoting fiber.
berry.Rindo.1: It has a tendency to expand into nearby plots, but attracts Pokémon that are holding items.
berry.Yache.0: This Berry has a refreshing flavor that strikes a good balance of dryness and sourness. It tastes better chilled.
berry.Yache.1: This Berry slows the decay of nearby Berries.
berry.Chople.0: This Berry contains a substance that generates heat. It can even heat up a chilly heart.
berry.Chople.1: Growing these Berries will promote Egg growth.
berry.Kebia.0: This Berry is a brilliant green on the outside. Inside, it is packed with a dry-flavored, black-colored flesh.
berry.Kebia.1: It has a tendency to overtake nearby plants.
berry.Kebia.2: Due to its poisonous nature, it increases the chances of mutations near it.
berry.Shuca.0: The sweetness-laden pulp has just the hint of a hard-edged and fragrant bite to it.
berry.Shuca.1: Growing this Berry will soften the ground around it, increasing the chances of replanting.
berry.Coba.0: This Berry is said to be a new kind that is a cross of two Berries brought together by winds from far away.
berry.Payapa.0: This Berry is said to sense human emotions for the way it swells roundly when a person approaches.
berry.Payapa.1: The same behavior affects nearby plants, causing additional mutations.
berry.Tanga.0: The flower grows at the tip of this Berry. It attracts Bug Pokémon by letting its stringy petals stream out.
berry.Tanga.1: The attracted Bug Pokémon decrease the amount of harvestable Berries in nearby plants.
berry.Charti.0: It is often used for pickles because of its very dry flavor. It can also be eaten raw for its provocative taste.
berry.Charti.1: This Berry plant hardens the surrounding soil, decreasing the chances of replanting.
berry.Kasib.0: Considered to have a special power from the olden days, this Berry is sometimes dried and used as a good-luck charm.
berry.Kasib.1: This Berry causes other nearby Berries to wither away faster.
berry.Haban.0: If a large enough volume of this Berry is boiled down, its bitterness fades away. It makes a good jam.
berry.Haban.1: This Berry requires a lot of energy to grow, but isn't fussy about what it consumes, it helps other plants by removing toxins from the soil.
berry.Colbur.0: Tiny hooks grow on the surface of this Berry. It latches on to Pokémon so it can be carried to far-off places.
berry.Colbur.1: It has a tendency to overtake nearby plants.
berry.Colbur.2: It also prevents Kasib from mutating.
berry.Babiri.0: This Berry is very tough with a strong flavor. It was used to make medicine by people in the past.
berry.Babiri.1: This Berry plant is very hardy and resistant, making it resistant to mutations, and also decreasing the chance of mutations around it.
berry.Chilan.0: This Berry can be cored out and dried to make a whistle. Blowing through its hole makes an indescribable sound.
berry.Roseli.0: This Berry is sweet with a hint of bitterness and has a lingering sweet scent. It is often dried and used to make tea.
berry.Roseli.1: The scent of this Berry plant attracts wild Pokémon.
berry.Snover.0: This berry grows around the waist of certain Snover.
berry.Micle.0: This Berry has a very dry flavor. It has the effect of making other food eaten at the same time taste sweet.
berry.Micle.1: The scent of this Berry plant repels wild Pokémon.
berry.Custap.0: The flesh underneath the Custap Berry's tough skin is sweet and creamy soft.
berry.Custap.1: This inspires Pokémon to train harder.
berry.Jaboca.0: The cluster of drupelets that make up this Berry pop rhythmically if the Berry is handled roughly.
berry.Jaboca.1: The sound of these Berries attracts rare wild Pokémon.
berry.Rowap.0: In days of old, people worked the top-shaped pieces of this Berry free and used them as toys.
berry.Rowap.1: These berries make catching efforts worth more.
berry.Kee.0: This Berry remains poisonous until fully ripened. Once ripe it has a spicy and sweet complex flavor.
berry.Maranga.0: This Berry resembles the Durin Berry, though its spikes are less pronounced. It is quite delicious when roasted.
berry.Liechi.0: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sea.
berry.Ganlon.0: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the land.
berry.Salac.0: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sky.
berry.Petaya.0: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of all living things.
berry.Petaya.1: This power revitalizes and prevents other berries from withering.
berry.Apicot.0: This is a very, very mystifying Berry. There is no telling how it can be used, or what may happen if it is used.
berry.Lansat.0: This is said to be a legendary Berry. Holding it supposedly brings great joy.
berry.Starf.0: This Berry is considered a mirage. It was said to be so strong that it had to be abandoned at the world's edge.
berry.Enigma.0: A completely enigmatic Berry. It apparently has the power of the stars that fill the night sky.
berry.Hopo.0: A truly mythical Berry native to harsh northern lands. It was first created by a Pokémon believed to have shaped the world.
